findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 1 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 1.1.4 2, 1.1.5 1, 1.2 2, 1.2.1 3, u-complex-polynomials-as-a-product-of-linear-factors 3, 1.3.1 2, 1.4 1, 1.4.1 2, 1.5 1, 1.5.1 1, 1.4.1~2 1, 1.3.3 5, u-complex-numbers-in-the-real-world-voltage-current-and-resist 2.

Main derivations of the unit (multiplicative inverse, square-root formula, cube and fourth roots of unity and their properties, product and quotient in polar form) and the main problem types (division, equality, square roots, factorization with the Rational Root Theorem, completing the square, omega identities, polar form, loci, AC current, encryption). Values are new; every step and result was checked by computation in Python (sympy). Book corrections followed: cube roots (-1 +/- sqrt(3) i)/2; r sin(theta) for the imaginary part (Example 12).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
